chapter.verse: “Ephesus khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen a taklam khut ah aksi sagih a tawi, kham meivaktau sagihte laka lampai mipa' thugen ahi hi.

“‘Na gamtatna, na hahkatna leh na lungduai thuakzawhna ahi zongin, mihoihlote koihkhong theilo-in sawltaka hilo pipi amauleamau hi a kicite sittelin zuau ahihlam na muhkhiatna ahi zongin, tua thute ka thei hi.
Keima' min na khualna-in lungduaina tawh thuak tentanin lungkia tuanlo na hihlam zong ka thei hi.
Himah taleh, cih ding khat kong nei hi. A masa lai-a na neih itna na khahsuah khin hi.

Tua ahih manin bang dinmun pana puk cih kiphawkin kisik inla, a masa lai-a na septe sem in. Na tuaci hih keileh nang' kiangah kong pai ding a, na kisik keileh nangma' meivaktau a mun pan kong lakkhiatsak ding hi.
Ahi zongin pahtak-huai thu zong na nei a, keimahmah in ka muhdah Nicolaus pawlte' gamtatna na mudah hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen. A gualzo mi' tungah Pasian' paradise sunga om nuntakna singkung a gah nek theihna thu ka pia ding hi.’
“Smyrna khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen si ngei-in a hingkik, a masabel leh a nunungbel mipa' thugen ahi hi:
“ ‘Na gimna, (hau napi-in) na zawnna leh Jew mi hilo pipi ka hi uh a ci, Satan' kipawlpihte' hong mindaisakna ka thei hi.

Tu-a na thuak kuan ahi gimna kihta kei in. En in, zia-etna na thuak nadingun dawimangpa in note kimkhat thong hong kiasak ding hita a, ni sawm sung gimna na tuak ding uh hi. Sih dongin citak in. Tua hileh nuntakna kumpi-lukhu kong guan ding hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen. A gualzo mi, sih nihna in sukha nawnlo ding hi.’
“Pergamum khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen langnih-hiam namsau a nei mipa' thugen ahi hi:

“‘Na tenna mun, Satan' kumpi-tokhom a omna mun, ka thei hi. Satan' omna muna om note' kianga a kithat, a citak keima' teci pangpa Antipas' hun lai nangawnin kei nong upna na nolh kei a, ka min na lenkip hi.

Himah taleh, cih ding tawmkhat kong nei hi: Israel mite milim thoihna an a nek nadingun leh nulepa tatkhialhna a bawl nadingun amau' mai-ah palkhaktheih thu a va koih dingin Balak' kianga a gen Balaam' thuhilhna a pom kimkhat na nei hi.
Tua mah bangin Nicolaus pawlte' thuhilhna a pom zong kimkhat na nei hi.
Tua ahih manin kisik in. Na kisik keileh nang' kiangah kong pai baih ding a, ka kam pana pusuak namsau tawh tua mite ka do ding hi.

Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen. A gualzo mi' tungah mannae a kiseelcip kimkhat ka pia ding a, min thak khat a kigelh suangtum a paak khat zong ka pia ding hi. Suangtum a ngah mite longal tua min a thei kuamah om lo hi.’
“Thyatira khua-a pawlpi' vanmi' tungah lai gelh in: ‘Hih pen meikuang tawh a kibang mittang a nei, a khete sumngo a kinawtngil tawh a kibang, Pasian' Tapa' thugen ahi hi:
“‘Na gamtatna, na itna, na upna, na tanukna, na lungduai thuakzawhna cihte ahi zongin, na gamtat a masa lamte sangin a nunung lamte hoihzaw cih ahi zongin, ka thei hi.
Himah taleh, cih ding khat kong nei hi. Amahmah kamsangnu kici-in thu a hilh, nulepa tatkhialhna a bawl dingin leh milim thoihna an a ne dingin ka silate a zolkhia numei Jezebel na awi-am hi.
Amah a kisik nading hun ka pia a, ahi zongin nulepa tatkhialhna pan amah kisik nuamlo hi.
En in, tua numeinu lupmun ngakin ka koih ding a, amah tawh angkikawm mite zong tua nu' sepkhiat teng a kisik kei uhleh gimna lianpi sung ka denna ding hi.

Tua nu' tanote zong sihna tawh ka vatlum ding hi. Tua ciangin kei pen lungsim leh lungtang a sittel ka hihlam pawlpite khempeuh in hong theician ding uh hi. Na sepkhiatte uh zui-in note khat ciat kong dinkik ding hi.
Ahi zongin tua thuhilhna a pom lo, Satan' thuthukte a kici tua thute a theician lo, Thyatira pawlpi sunga om a dang teng' kiang kong genin ah, note' tungah vangik bangmah kong suan kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin tu-a na neih pen uh mah kong pai dongin na lenkip un.
A gualzo mi leh keima' sepkhiatte a tawp dongin a zomsuak mi' tungah minamte' tunga uktheihna thu ka guan ding hi.
Amah in sik ciangkhut tawh tua mite uk ding a, leibeel bangin amaute satkham ding hi.
Keimahmah in ka Pa' kiangpan uktheihna thu ngah khinzo ka hih mah bangin ama' tungah zingsol ka pia ding hi.
Bil a nei khempeuh in pawlpite' tunga Kha' genkhiat thu za ta hen.’
